title: Why Mega Man is blue
caption: Mega Man is blue because of the NES color palette. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #megaman #capcom

instagram.caption:
Mega Man is blue for a technical reason.

The NES palette had more shades of blue than anything else, so a blue character could look more detailed with the colors available.

Keiji Inafune and the Capcom team designed around that limit, and the Blue Bomber was born.

What color would you have made him?
